svg.title: Pranay Kadu — BackendArchitectX
svg.desc: Backend Software Engineer. Java, Spring Boot, Distributed Systems, AWS, Kafka, SQL and Redis. A cute little robot with a red tiled cap, green face and amber eyes waves, blinks and hops. This is a looping illustration. Open the linked interactive version to make its head follow your mouse. Transparent background, theme-aware text and a reduced-motion still.

g.text: Build for failure. Preserve the invariant.
